name: Leneler Hof
beschreibung: The Leneler Hof is a hotel in Austrian Tirol. It is located off the main roads in a quiet setting with views of the surrounding mountain peaks. The accommodation offers comfortable rooms with traditional furniture and modern comforts. The amenities include a wellness area with sauna and steam bath as well as a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The atmosphere is characterized by the hospitality of Tirol and tranquility. The target group consists primarily of hikers in summer and skiers in winter.
